errors.claim: How Does the USA Compare on Daily Poverty?
errors.reason: A 'Why' or comparative question title claims a cause or comparison that must match evidence; here, the title frames a comparison of the USA, but the evidence shows multiple countries.

errors.claim: DR Congo has 78 times the poverty found in the USA at 1.1%.
errors.reason: 85.3 divided by 1.1 is approximately 77.54, which rounds to 78, but the ratio claim should be exact or supported by a clear calculation.

claims.text: In DR Congo, 85.3% of the population lives on less than $3.00 a day.
DR Congo has 78 times the poverty found in the USA at 1.1%.
India has 2.6% living below this daily mark.
Nigeria stands at 41.8% of its population.
Ukraine hits 0% on the global scale.
